meta.title: Notify sound
meta.description: Plays theme short sounds for completed, failed, and waiting-for-confirmation events while the window is in the background, with mute, volume, per-event toggles, and anti-repeat throttling.

ui.title: Notification sounds
ui.hint: Configure audio alerts for completed, failed, and waiting-for-confirmation turns. Manual cancellations stay silent. Max 2 MB per file, capped at 10s.
ui.tooLarge: Audio file exceeds the size limit.
ui.decodeFailed: Cannot decode this audio file in the desktop player.
ui.unsupported: Only WAV, MP3, OGG, M4A, FLAC, and WebM files are supported.
ui.uploadFailed: Audio upload failed; please try again.
